Relations change only by BYPASS dependsOn rewiring of the current state; no value/health/flag/channel/oracle field is read.

boundary.supersedes: Stage 3G.7 contract field map for the projection only; inherited conclusions unchanged
OBSERVED: entity in-service bit (= available && health>0, rendered glyph case)
actor energy, health, carried material, ticks remaining, cell, terrain
DERIVED: relative position, Manhattan and observed-map path distance, direction
t0 offered-legality predicates (protected/damaged/planned/acceptsMaterial positive only, at t0)
declared-cost E1 ledger (energy, tick, position, carried emptying)
PROSPECTIVE_AUDIT_ONLY: canonical relation type (TYPED_RELATION_DISCLOSURE_CANDIDATE_V1): observable in the environment presentation, dropped before adapter output, not runtime-approved
UNKNOWN: available flag (service=false does not separate available=false from health=0)
planned flag (except positive offered BUILD at t0)
acceptsMaterial (except positive offered TRANSFER at t0)
protected flag (except offered PROTECT / ledger PROTECT)
BYPASS substitute identity under the coarse contract
terminal state of any future branch
PRIVILEGED: KERNEL_PRIVATE_GEOMETRY: canonical frame (argmin of a digest over the full kernel geometry)
HIDDEN_ORIENTATION: the seed-bound D4 orientation of the scenario
HIDDEN_ORIENTATION: base-frame direction of any action
FUTURE_STATE: temporal channel values beyond the current tick
ROLLOUT_RESULTS: terminal outcome of any branch
SYNTHETIC_LABELS: labels produced by the corpus generator
KERNEL_DIGESTS_AND_INTERNALS: entity value / cost / risk / non-actor health / resources / private flags

limits.population: Balanced known-composition benchmark; unit weights, not natural prevalence.
limits.cohorts: BYPASS cohorts are conditional on BYPASS being offered; population weight 0.
limits.heads: Linear heads fit on the reused Stage 3G.7 OPEN set (horizon>2); BYPASS is rare in OPEN, so learned typed-relation weights have little BYPASS training signal; the oracle VOI audit is the head-independent measure.
limits.voi: One coarse-consistent multiset-preserving retyping per row; descriptive oracle bound, not a deployable policy.
limits.search: Caps 1024/2048 and depth 3 not re-tested; inherited.
